ctx.x: Back to this job in Sacramento, there was another night club that stayed open a little later than us. It was the Club Eureka. I forget the bandleader's name. But there were two marvelous musicians, tenor saxophone player named George Neely, out of Oklahoma City, and a trumpet player,
migrated from Kansas City, his name was Flowers. Can't recall his first name. But he had a drinking problem.

After getting back to Los Angeles, and my foot episode, I got another job as a bandleader. And in this job, I had a tenor saxophone player named Hank Full i love, who wrote books, Western books, and no one knew it. And he was getting royalties all the time, during that time. And the piano player was George Crawford, that has a duo, he and a Grand Mason here in Los Angeles. He worked with me. And the drummer's name was Bob Brown.
